title: welcome-flow
universal_lens: A Bayesian readiness gate \( R(t) \in \{0,1\} \) controls signal publication, conditioned on historical calibration and market depth. The system enforces a four-check protocol: \( M \) market integrity, \( E \) edge explainability, \( L \) slow learning, and \( G \) gated output.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal predictive inference to calibrate \( R(t) \) using \( \mathcal{D}_{\text{settled}} \), ensuring \( P(\text{signal} \mid \mathcal{D}) \geq \alpha \) before release. The \( \text{Gate}(\cdot) \) operator filters inputs via \( \mathcal{F}(\text{market}) \wedge \mathcal{E}(\text{edge}) \wedge \mathcal{L}(\text{learning}) \wedge \mathcal{G}(\text{output}) \).
gse_mapping: GSE models the state transition \( S_{t} \to S_{t+1} \) as a Markov chain over \( \mathcal{H} \) (historical data) and \( \mathcal{R} \) (readiness gate). Each email constitutes a \( \text{SignalEvent}(t) \) that updates \( S_t \) based on \( \mathcal{F}(\text{methodology}) \) and \( \mathcal{G}(\text{gate}) \).

reasoning_traces.think:
The system operates under a dual logic: first, a readiness gate \( \mathcal{R}(t) \) ensures that only sufficiently calibrated data is released. This is modeled as a binary condition dependent on \( \mathcal{D}_{\text{settled}} \). Second, a four-check protocol \( \mathcal{F} \wedge \mathcal{E} \wedge \mathcal{L} \wedge \mathcal{G} \) governs signal validation. Each check represents a distinct constraint: market integrity, edge explainability, slow learning, and output gating. These form a logical conjunction that must hold for any signal to pass. The silent collection phase \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{silent}} \) is a pre-publication state where \( \mathcal{R}(t) = 0 \), allowing data to accumulate without public exposure. The transition from \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{silent}} \) to \( \mathcal{S}_{\text{public}} \) occurs when \( \mathcal{R}(t) = 1 \). The entire process is deterministic within its constraints, with no retroactive correction allowed once an email is sent. This design prevents overfitting and maintains epistemic rigor.
